modmenu.descriptionTranslation.triwasa: Litematica compatibility for FCA V2-Extra easy place, the FCA big ender chest terminal, optional Quick Shulker hand restocking, a client item pickup filter, and fixes for other client mods.
triwasa.gui.title: TriWasa Configs
triwasa.config.porting.comment.easyPlace: Enables the client-side V2-Extra easy-place protocol after the server confirms support. Use [+] to show its sub-options.
Stores whether the Easy Place sub-options are expanded.
triwasa.config.porting.prettyName.easyPl: Preserve Rail Shape During Easy Place
triwasa.config.porting.comment.easyPlace: Requests that the server preserve the projected rail shape during this easy-place operation.
triwasa.config.porting.prettyName.easyPl: Lock Crafter Slots During Easy Place
triwasa.config.porting.comment.easyPlace: Copies disabled crafter slots from the schematic when placing a crafter.
triwasa.config.utilities.comment.quickSh: Restocks the item already held in the selected hotbar slot from carried shulker boxes when its count becomes low. This follows the held item and does not use the schematic material list. Requires Quick Shulker on both client and server.
triwasa.config.utilities.prettyName.quic: Expand Quick Shulker Hand Restock Sub-options
triwasa.config.utilities.comment.quickSh: Stores whether the Quick Shulker hand restock sub-options are expanded.
Restock the selected hotbar stack when its remaining count reaches this value.
triwasa.config.big_ender_chest.comment.b: Uses the custom FCA protocol v2 terminal after the server accepts the handshake. Use [+] to show its sub-options.
triwasa.config.big_ender_chest.prettyNam: Expand Big Ender Chest Terminal Sub-options
triwasa.config.big_ender_chest.comment.b: Stores whether the big ender chest terminal sub-options are expanded.
Selects the slot amount text size. Small abbreviates from 10000 with four characters; large abbreviates from 1000 with three.
Sorts the complete local index by name or total count.
Chooses ascending or descending local sorting.
Keeps the current local search text until the client closes.
triwasa.config.pickup_filter.comment.ite: Enables the client-side pickup filter. Use [+] to show its sub-options.
Stores whether the item pickup filter sub-options are expanded.
BLACKLIST drops listed items. WHITELIST drops every item that is not listed.
Item IDs or #item tags, one per line. Missing namespaces default to minecraft:.
Rarity names: common, uncommon, rare, and epic.
Choose whether filtered drops are silent, shown above the hotbar, or written to chat.
Allows items to be picked up normally while the sneak key is held.

triwasa.big_ender_chest.help.body:
LMB: stack; RMB: half
Shift+LMB: to inventory
Q / Ctrl+Q: drop; drag slots here
